statement:
∀ (f : PowerSeries ℚ) (num den : Polynomial ℚ) (hden : den ≠ 0)
    (hrel : PowerSeries.X * (Polynomial.aeval f den) = Polynomial.aeval f num), ∃ P : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℚ, P ≠ 0 ∧
      P.eval₂ (algebraMap ℚ (PowerSeries ℚ))
